## What's new

Threadnote 5.3.0-beta.5 prepares Gemma 4 in the background and makes topic updates clearer from generation to applied changes.

### Gemma ready when you need it

Eligible standalone installs and updates now download and verify the pinned Gemma 4 model in the background. Manager shows setup progress and recovery actions. Your explicit provider and model choices stay intact; automatic selection applies only where you have not made a choice.

The model download is approximately 4.6 GB. Threadnote checks memory and disk space first, and setup never starts a draft or loads the generation model automatically. Inspect it with `threadnote models setup --status`, pause with `threadnote models setup --auto off`, or retry with `threadnote models setup --retry`.

### Clearer topic reviews

Topic and citation reviews use distinct source cards, quotations, badges and clearer spacing. The primary Generate draft button shows activity while generation runs. After a confirmed update, Manager shows success, closes the dialog and immediately removes the resolved item and its counts. Proposed memory text is readable, with canonical metadata available separately.
